# Edward Suarez

DevOps & SRE engineer based in Medellín, Colombia (UTC-5), open to remote roles. Technology career since November 2020.

- UST / Banco Santander: Nov 2024 – Present. Production releases, monitoring and Bash automation for incident response at Banco Santander.
- Pragma / Bancolombia: Aug 2023 – Nov 2024. Automation and implementation of SRE practices for Sucursal Virtual Personas and Mi Bancolombia.
- Mercado Libre: Nov 2021 – May 2023. Professional backend development in Go.
- SETI: Aug 2021 – Nov 2021. AWS migration work spanning project configuration, connectivity and identity.
- Almícava (Integ.ro): Nov 2020 – Aug 2021. Bash automation, environment setup, production deployments and recovery from backups.

Certifications: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner; Claude Certified Developer - Foundations (Anthropic).
Coravit: independent ecommerce project built with AI-assisted engineering.
